facts.text: §7.1–7.4 forbids trading inconsistent with professional standards, disproportionate sizes and significant trade count variation; provider “sole discretion” determines forbidden practice, removal of trades from history and P/L calculations. Base Camp payout eligibility expressly requires §7 compliance.
§12.2 grounds include “behavior that is detrimental to the Provider’s business reputation, partners, or technology”; §12.3–12.4 discretionary enforcement, no refund/compensation/restoration.
§9.1–9.4 customer may receive third-party contract only after successful completion of relevant stages; funding partner discretion and payout terms outside Alpine contract.
§4.7 any chargeback or attempted chargeback permanently revokes payout eligibility for past/current/future purchased accounts; no compensation.

rejected.B1: Third-party admission discretion is pre-entitlement, not unconditional cancellation of earned payouts. Need actual partner contract.
rejected.B5: §7.4 excludes trades from profit/loss calculations, not express asymmetry.
